fields.schemeName: Asangathit Karmakaar Silai Machine Sahayata Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Asangathit Karmakaar Silai Machine Sahayata Yojana started by the Government of Chhattisgarh in 2012.

fields.schemeName: Yuva Srujan Puraskar (Navsarjan Chetana Puraskar)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Yuva Srujan Puraskar (Navsarjan Chetana Puraskar)" is designed to honour the young Goan individuals who have excelled in the field of Art and culture in Goa. The scheme intends to give recognition to young artists par excellence for their outstanding achievements.

fields.schemeName: Development of Choir Industries
fields.briefDescription: The Government of Puducherry introduced the Scheme Development Of Choir Industries to promote and develop Coir and Coir based industry in the Union territory of Puducherry.

fields.schemeName: OEC Pre-matric Educational Assistance
fields.briefDescription: The Scheme “OEC Pre-matric Educational Assistance” was started by the Backward Classes Development Department, Government of Kerala to provide educational assistance to pre-matric students belonging to these communities who are studying in Government/Aided/Unaided schools from Classes 1st to 10th.

fields.schemeName: KSCSTE Emeritus Scientist Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “KSCSTE Emeritus Scientist Scheme” helps to provide opportunity to superannuated outstanding scientists to pursue research in their respective field of specialization and to harness their knowledge and erudition for the development of State.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Pre-matric Scholarship to Other Backward Classes (OBC) for Studies in India
fields.briefDescription: "Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Pre-matric Scholarship to Other Backward Classes for Studies in India" is a Scholarship Scheme by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment. The objective is to award scholarships to school-going children of poorer OBC parents.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Raut, Charavaaha Evan Doodh Duhane Vaale Saayakal Sahaayata Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Mukhyamantri Raut, Charavaaha Evan Doodh Duhane Vaale Bicycle Sahaayata Yojana" for unorganized worker on 10 September 2013.

fields.schemeName: Safai Karmakar Bahay Rogi Chikitsa Sahayata Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Safai Karmakar Bahay Rogi Chikitsa Sahayata Yojana" for unorganized worker on 11 March 2015.

fields.schemeName: Swatantrata Sainik Samman Pension Scheme
fields.briefDescription: Launched on 15th August 1972, "Swatantrata Sainik Samman Pension Scheme" is a Pension Scheme by the Ministry of Home Affairs. The scheme provides the grant of pension to living freedom fighters and their families; if they are no more alive, and to the families or martyrs.

fields.schemeName: Abdul Kalam Technology Innovation National Fellowship
fields.briefDescription: Indian National Academy of Engineering (INAE) will award "Abdul Kalam Technology Innovation National Fellowship" to outstanding engineers to recognize, encourage and support translational research by individuals to achieve excellence in engineering, innovation and technology development.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: Green Business Scheme
fields.briefDescription: Green Business Scheme has been launched by the National Safai Karamcharis Finance and Development Corporation to provide financial assistance in the form of loans for activities that can tackle the impacts of climate change and also be income-generating.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance for the Purchase of Lifejackets and Lifebuoys for Fishermen
fields.briefDescription: “Financial Assistance for the Purchase of Lifejackets and Lifebuoys for Fishermen” is a scheme by the Dept. of Fisheries, Govt. of Goa. Through this scheme, financial assistance amounting to ₹50% is provided by the Government to eligible fishermen for the Purchase of Lifejackets and Lifebuoys.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance to Purchase Outboard Motor of 2HP to 5 HP for Fitting to the Fishing Canoe
fields.briefDescription: “Financial Assistance to Purchase Outboard Motor of 2HP to 5 HP for Fitting to the Fishing Canoe” is a scheme by the Department of Fisheries, Government of Goa. This Scheme has been introduced to grant financial assistance in the form of a subsidy on the purchase of an outboard motor of 2HP to 5HP.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance to Purchase/Construct New Fishing Craft less than 26 feet for Fishing in Inland Waters of Goa
fields.briefDescription: The scheme has been introduced to uplift the sizeable community of traditional Fishermen, by providing them financial help in the form of subsidy on the construction/ purchase of Fishing Craft less than 26 feet for fishing in inland waters of Goa. The applications are accepted only in offline mode.

fields.schemeName: Technology Fellowship and Patent Promotion Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to identify technology educators in technical educational institutes in Goa who are keen to further their expertise. The selected educators/fellows would be sent to Centres of Excellence within the country and abroad to undertake summer school and short-term training.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance To Purchase Singel Net / Small Rampon Net & Its Accessories
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Financial Assistance To Purchase Singel Net / Small Rampon Net & Its Accessories” is a scheme by the Department of Fisheries, Government of Goa. Through this scheme, a 50% subsidy is provided to the fishermen of Goa for the purchase of Singel Net/ Small Rampon Net and its accessories.

fields.schemeName: Award of Adhoc Merit Grant (Special Incentive) to Scheduled Caste Students
fields.briefDescription: The scheme is implemented as a sort of encouragement for the Scheduled Caste students who secure 65% or above marks in matriculation/SSLC Board of Examinations.

fields.schemeName: Grant Of Retention Scholarship to Scheduled Caste Girl Students
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to Scheduled Caste Girls Students to pursue their studies in Primary Education. Because of this assistance, the parents of those students may not lose any income that they would otherwise get by sending their girls to work.

fields.schemeName: Bina Mulya Samajik Suraksha Yojana
fields.briefDescription: "Bina Mulya Samajik Suraksha Yojana (BM-SSY)" is a comprehensive social security scheme for unorganized workers in the state of West Bengal, India. It was launched by the West Bengal government in 2017.

fields.schemeName: Supply of Insulated Boxes
fields.briefDescription: A subsidy to the extent of 75% of the cost for the purchase of an insulated box of at least 50 liters capacity. Only the fisherman engaged in selling and marketing fish, fishing at sea with a canoe, and fishing at sea with a mechanized fishing vessel with upto 6-cylinder engines are eligible.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance to the Fish Vendors Registered with the Directorate of Fisheries to Purchase the Accessories Required for Fish Vending
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, Financial Assistance is provided to the fish vendors for the purchase of Crates, Weighing Balance, Insulated Box, Gloves, Stools, Platforms to keep Fish/ Shed/ Umbrella, Choppers, and Other Equipment, so that the fish can reach the people in hygienic conditions.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Purchase of Stake Net and its Accessories
fields.briefDescription: “Financial Assistance for Purchase of Stake Net and its Accessories” is a scheme by the Dept. of Fisheries, Govt. of Goa. Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided in the form of a subsidy on the purchase of stake nets and accessories for the fishermen.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Shramik Siyaan Sahayata Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Mukhyamantri Shramik Siyaan Sahayata Yojana" for construction worker on 12 May 2022.

fields.schemeName: Subsidy for the Purchase of Wooden/Fiber Reinforced Plastic/Steel Mechanised Boats
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Subsidy for the Purchase of Wooden/Fiber Reinforced Plastic/Steel Mechanised Boats" is introduced by the Government of Puducherry with the objective of increasing marine fish production by extending subsidies for the procurement of wooden/fiber-reinforced plastic/steel mechanized boats.

fields.schemeName: Grant of Subsidy for Procurement of Vehicle
fields.briefDescription: "Grant of Subsidy for Procurement of Vehicle" aims to facilitate the quick transportation of fish catches from landing centers to marketing places, thereby preventing/minimizing spoilage of fish. It provides a 50% subsidy for the procurement of specified vehicles.

fields.schemeName: Mukhya mantri Krishak Udyami Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to the sons and daughters of farmers to establish their businesses. the government of Madhya Pradesh provided loans to the bank for all citizens of the state.

fields.schemeName: Amma Two Wheeler Scheme for Working Women
fields.briefDescription: The Amma Two-wheeler is a scheme that will empower working women in Tamil Nadu State.

fields.schemeName: Opening and Maintenance of Boys and Girls Hostels
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Opening and Maintenance of Boys and Girls Hostels” by the Adi Dravidar Welfare Dept, Government of Puducherry, provides boarding/lodging and hostel facilities to Scheduled Caste students in pursuance of their education and to dissuade dropping of education at school and college level.

fields.schemeName: Award of Pre-matric Scholarship to the Students Whose Parents Are Engaged in Unclean Occupation
fields.briefDescription: "Award of Pre-matric Scholarship to the Students Whose Parents Are Engaged in Unclean Occupation” by the Adi Dravidar Welfare Dept, Govt of Puducherry, provides scholarships to the students whose parents are engaged in unclean occupations to improve the status of the unprivileged society.

fields.schemeName: Widow Pension (CBOCWWB)
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, financial assistance in the form of a monthly pension shall be given to the widows of male registered construction workers of the Board.

fields.schemeName: Scholarship to the Ward of Beneficiary (CBOCWWB)
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, financial assistance in the form of scholarship shall be granted to the children/wards of workers who are registered under the CBOCWWB on the basis of the percentage of marks obtained in 10th, 12th & Graduation.

fields.schemeName: Biju Patnaik Bravery Award
fields.briefDescription: The “Biju Patnaik Bravery Award” was launched by the Sports & Youth Services Department, Government of Odisha to recognize spectacular acts of Bravery performed by people of Odisha.

fields.schemeName: Educational Allowances to the Children of Widows
fields.briefDescription: “Educational Allowances to the Children of Widows” by the Dept of Women & Child Development, Govt of Pondicherry, was introduced to provide financial assistance (₹25 to ₹125) for the education of poor widows' children up to higher secondary or equivalent.

fields.schemeName: Balika Samrithi Yojana
fields.briefDescription: “Balika Samrithi Yojana” by the Dept of Women & Child Development, Govt of Pondicherry was introduced to improve the status of the girl child and provide nutritious food to the girl child. Financial assistance of ₹500 in the form of a National Savings Certificate is provided to lactating mothers.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance to Poor Scheduled Caste People Suffering From Prolonged Diseases
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Financial Assistance to Poor Scheduled Caste People Suffering From Prolonged Diseases” was introduced by the Adi Dravidar Welfare Dept, Govt of Puducherry. The objective of the scheme is to assist poor patients from Scheduled Castes suffering from prolonged illness.

fields.schemeName: Awasiya Vidyala Yojana
fields.briefDescription: "Awasiye Vidyala Yojana" initiated by the Labor Department of the Uttar Pradesh State for the education of the construction worker.

fields.schemeName: Aravanaippu Illam
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Aravanaippu Illam" was launched by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Puducherry. The objective of this scheme is to take care of persons who are lacking basic needs & proper care in society, and to maintain them in a safe living condition.

fields.schemeName: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme-Madhya Pradesh
fields.briefDescription: The Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme is being operated to provide financial support to widowed women living below the poverty line.

fields.schemeName: “Medical Camps (Allopathy and Indian systems of Medicine)" under Grant-in-Aid to Pondicherry Society for the Care of the Aged (PONCARE)
fields.briefDescription: “Medical Camps (Allopathy and Indian systems of Medicine)" under the umbrella scheme "Grant-in-Aid to Pondicherry Society for the Care of the Aged" was launched by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Puducherry. The senior citizens are provided free health checkups and free medicines.

fields.schemeName: Grant of Financial Assistance to Differently Abled Person
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Grant of Financial Assistance to Differently Abled Person” by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Puducherry was introduced to provide monthly financial assistance to Persons with Disability to maintain their minimum standard of living.

fields.schemeName: Post Harvest Marketing Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The “Post Harvest Marketing Scheme” was launched by the Department of Agriculture & Farmers’ Welfare, Government of Meghalaya for the creation of post harvest marketing infrastructure.

fields.schemeName: Divyang Shiksha Protsahan Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, the Madhya Pradesh government provides financial support to Disabled children of the state.

fields.schemeName: Supply of Invalid Carriages (Motorized Tri-cycles) to the Persons With Disabilities
fields.briefDescription: “Supply of Invalid Carriages (Motorized Tri-cycles) to the Persons With Disabilities” by the Dept of Social Welfare, Govt of Puducherry is introduced to supply invalid carriages (motorised tricycles) free of cost to the differently abled persons engaged in gainful employment or pursuing education.

fields.schemeName: Supply of Prosthetic Appliances to Differently Abled Persons
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Supply of Prosthetic Appliances to Differently Abled Persons” was launched by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Puducherry. In this scheme, prosthetic appliances are supplied to differently-abled persons free of cost to minimize the mobility challenges experienced by them.

fields.schemeName: Assistance to Scheduled Caste Farmers for Installation of Submersible / Centrifugal Motor Pumpsets With Accessories
fields.briefDescription: Through this scheme, the farmers from the Scheduled Caste Category are provided with a grant of 90% subsidy towards the installation of suitable Submersible / Centrifugal motor pump sets with accessories, subject to a maximum of ₹60,000/‐ per tubewell per individual.

fields.schemeName: Grant of Transport Allowance to Differently Abled Persons
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Grant of Transport Allowance to Differently Abled Persons" was launched by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Puducherry. In this scheme, a fixed sum ₹ 300/- per month shall be paid as Transport Allowance to the differently abled individuals.

fields.schemeName: 6 Varsh Se Adhik Aayu Ke Bahuviklang Aur Mansik Roop Se Aviksit Nisaktjan Ke Liye Sahayata Anudan Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is M.P. To assist multiple handicapped and mentally underdeveloped persons above the age of six years who are unable to earn a living.

fields.schemeName: Agriculture Research Stations and Laboratories Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to conduct adaptive research trials on different crops in the Research Farms and in Farmers' Field for adaptability and use of bio pesticides/bio agents.

fields.schemeName: Maintenance of Horti Hubs
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to procure good quality disease-free and commercially accepted varieties of the identified flowers and multiply and, to serve as a demonstration cum training ground for those who are interested in Floriculture and who intend to make this as their means of livelihood.

fields.schemeName: Nirman Shramik Auzaar Toolkit Sahayata Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The NIRMAN SHRAMIK AUZAAR TOOLKIT SAHAYATA YOJANA is a social welfare scheme launched by the Government of Jharkhand to provide financial assistance to registered construction workers in the state for the purchase of essential tools and equipment required for their work.
